thesis: Sean Rad argues that Tinder was built on the core thesis of acting as an ephemeral matchmaker to remove the fear of rejection and anxiety associated with approaching strangers. He emphasizes that the product was designed to be passive and magical, prioritizing product-market fit and quality feedback over marketing, while initially positioning itself as a social discovery platform rather than a traditional online dating service.
